mutations.name: the authority allow is reached before the old-path gate
kills: the old-path merge guard under an exited M1b an untagged old-path head gates as old-path-untagged and names the files and the task

mutations.name: an advisory verdict gates
kills: the old-path merge guard before M1b exit an untagged old-path head is recorded as advisory and decides as before

mutations.name: the record drops the old-path verdict
kills: the old-path merge guard a head whose task carries superseded-at:M3 decides as before, and the record names its tag

mutations.name: the judge is called on unread files
kills: the old-path merge guard a head whose files are unread gates only as files-unread, and the old-path read is not called

mutations.name: the registered task is not read
kills: the old-path merge guard the evidence route judges the task and kind the run was registered with
